name: EuroCrops: Harmonised Pan-European Crop Parcel Dataset
description: EuroCrops is a large-scale, open-source agricultural parcel collection compiled by the Technical University of Munich (TUM) and the German Aerospace Center (DLR), published in Nature Scientific Data. It harmonizes publicly accessible European Land Parcel Identification System (LPIS) declaration records from 16 European nations into a unified, cross-border semantic taxonomy called the Hierarchical Crop Alignment Taxonomy (HCAT). Covering over 10 million agricultural parcel vector geometries and crop classifications across Austria, Germany, France, Slovenia, Estonia, Latvia, Portugal, Romania, and the Netherlands, EuroCrops provides a standardized benchmark for training and evaluating transnational satellite crop type classification and earth observation models.
